prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: USER REVIEW concept board PNG for a Chiikawa-inspired bowl-shaped 2.5D falling-head merge puzzle map.
Create ONE polished landscape review sheet with two equally sized panels showing THE SAME bowl profile and colors:
LEFT panel: the finished exterior illustration of a cute wide-mouth ramen/rice bowl. Warm ivory ceramic with blush pink rim, very light powder-blue bottom accent and restrained tiny star/dot motifs, one small simple Chiikawa round-ear face decoration on the OUTSIDE lower front of bowl. Gentle matte ceramic 2.5D volume, dark warm brown delicate outlines and soft upper-left lighting. Wide open mouth; sides taper GENTLY inward toward a broad SHORT FLAT bottom with rounded bottom corners. Make the vessel pleasantly deep enough to stack heads: top opening width about 1.6 times interior depth; bottom width about 60% of top opening. Avoid a shallow saucer or sharp V funnel. Bowl foot is short and stable. Sparse pale steam curls above exterior view.
RIGHT panel: matching FRONT CUTAWAY REVIEW illustration of exactly that same bowl. The front wall is removed to expose an EMPTY cream-colored stacking cavity; render the ceramic shell as a thin pastel pink/ivory band immediately OUTSIDE the playable cavity. Overlay ONE highly legible solid turquoise U-shaped collision boundary INSIDE the bowl: starts at left inner rim, descends gently inward along left side, rounds into short wide horizontal floor, rounds up right side to right inner rim. This is a CONTINUOUS OPEN-TOP U; absolutely NO turquoise horizontal line across the opening, NO ellipse across play area, NO hooks or ridges. The collision boundary and inside ceramic edge must visually coincide. No interior ledges or objects. A thin turquoise leader line points to side wall and a second to flat floor. To far right of this panel add a small inset of that same open-top U profile as a pure line silhouette, with a downward arrow above its opening; this inset is a legend only.
Board styling: off-white subtle warm paper backdrop, generous breathing room, beautiful clear high-quality art presentation. Text must be sparse and exact English only: top title "BOWL MAP / v1"; subtitle "DRAFT - USER REVIEW"; panel titles "EXTERIOR" and "COLLISION REVIEW"; legend "CYAN = INNER COLLISION EDGE"; small bottom note "OPEN TOP / SOFT TAPER / FLAT BASE". No other text. No checkerboard, no photo mockup, no screenshot, no watermarks. Show entire bowl, full rim, and all collision lines with comfortable margins. No floating character heads inside the cavity, no food/noodles, no chopsticks or tall utensils, no game UI, no buttons, no physics values. This is a review concept illustration, not a production texture, not a final Godot collision specification.
